Tox encrypts content between peers. Direct contacts can learn your IP address; public bootstrap and relay nodes can observe network metadata. Tor is not integrated. Tox is experimental and has not had a complete independent security audit.
Identity and contacts are encrypted using Android Keystore. This alpha keeps chat history only in memory (up to 200 messages per contact). Android backups and screenshots are disabled.
A transport receipt does not prove a human read the message. In-flight packets may arrive during a brief interruption before disconnection is detected. No application retry queue or server mailbox exists.

1. Create an identity on each device. 2. Open My identity and share your invitation. 3. Your friend adds the invitation; accept the request on this device. 4. Verify public keys through a trusted channel. 5. Keep both apps visible; open a contact and send a message when Available.
Connection may take a minute or fail on restrictive networks. Try another network. Leaving the app disconnects it; returning reconnects without resending messages.
Do not uninstall or clear app storage: account migration and backup are not implemented yet. This alpha has no calls, media, file transfer, linked devices or remote deletion.
